_meta.rule: Video-level split (no frames of a test video are used for tuning). Videos 1-8 go to dev because every pipeline threshold so far (STR gate, VAP cut-offs, frame QC, tracker) was tuned on them and the detector was trained on their frames. Videos 9-23 (unseen by the detector) are sorted by lab total motility and alternately assigned test/dev, so both sets span 0-96% motility and 15-266 M/mL.
_meta.usage: Tune on dev only. Report test once per change; never pick settings by looking at test.
_meta.excluded: Videos 18 and 23 are excluded from every evaluation (too blurry / unusable field). Their annotation files are kept on disk; they are just not scored.
